WITH period_end AS (
  SELECT period_end_date AS as_of_date, period_end_date - INTERVAL 1 YEAR + INTERVAL 1 DAY AS window_start
  FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND fiscal_period = 8
), tier_at_date AS (
  SELECT m.member_id, m.tier FROM dim_member m, period_end p
  WHERE p.as_of_date BETWEEN m.valid_from AND m.valid_to
), buyers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = f.member_key
  CROSS JOIN period_end p
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN p.window_start AND p.as_of_date
    AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag
)
SELECT t.tier, count(*) AS active_members
FROM tier_at_date t JOIN buyers b USING (member_id)
GROUP BY t.tier
ORDER BY CASE t.tier WHEN 'Basic' THEN 1 WHEN 'Silver' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END
